# 7485 - 4-bit comparator

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7485.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7485.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 19 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7485 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7485.png) | ![7485 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-7485.png) | ![7485 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-7485.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | B3 | input |  |  |
| 2 | A&lt;Bin | input |  | cascade input from a less significant stage |
| 3 | A=Bin | input |  | cascade input; tie high on the least significant stage |
| 4 | A&gt;Bin | input |  | cascade input from a less significant stage |
| 5 | A&gt;Bout | output | totem-pole |  |
| 6 | A=Bout | output | totem-pole |  |
| 7 | A&lt;Bout | output | totem-pole |  |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 9 | B0 | input |  |  |
| 10 | A0 | input |  |  |
| 11 | B1 | input |  |  |
| 12 | A1 | input |  |  |
| 13 | A2 | input |  |  |
| 14 | B2 | input |  |  |
| 15 | A3 | input |  |  |
| 16 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | A&gt;Bout = (A &gt; B) OR ((A = B) AND A=Bin' AND A&lt;Bin') | High when the word A3..A0 is greater than B3..B0. When the words are equal it is high when the A=B and A&lt;B cascade inputs are both low (so A&gt;Bin=H gives H, and all three cascade inputs low gives H as well, per the '85 function table). |
| 7 | A&lt;Bout = (A &lt; B) OR ((A = B) AND A=Bin' AND A&gt;Bin') | High when A3..A0 is less than B3..B0. When the words are equal it is high when the A=B and A&gt;B cascade inputs are both low. |
| 6 | A=Bout = (A = B) AND A=Bin | High only when the words are equal and the A=B cascade input is high. |

## Not known

- Maximum data-to-output delay for the 1- and 2-gate-level paths: the table gives typical values only.
- Which data input takes how many gate levels to A&lt;Bout/A&gt;Bout: the table does not say; the 3-level row is the one with a maximum.

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
